historySection.title: Our History
historySection.subtitle: Founded in 1995, EEC Cologne Church has grown from a small gathering to a thriving community. We have served thousands of families and individuals, providing worship, education, and community support.

paragraphs.title: A Humble Beginning
paragraphs.content: The spiritual journey of the Cologne Church began on April 16, 1995. Our beginning was humble, as we initially gathered in the homes of a few believers. Despite these small beginnings, our hunger for the Word of God was immense. This period of prayer and fellowship in homes laid the foundation for our growth. As God opened more doors, we transitioned to meeting in smaller halls.

paragraphs.title: From a Migrant Church to a Settled Community
paragraphs.content: In the early years of our history, our church primarily served as a spiritual haven for students and migrants who had come to Germany for studies or temporary stays. Many members would return to their home countries after completing their education, yet the church persisted in faithfully sowing the Word of God. Through God's grace, this dynamic has evolved over time. Today, our church has transformed into a stable and deep-rooted community of permanent residents. After 21 years of faithful fellowship, this stability led to our formal registration as Äthiopische Evangelische Gemeinde Köln Mühlheim e.V. at the District Court of Cologne (Amtsgericht Köln) under the registration number VR 19124 on November 24, 2016. This transition has provided the church with greater stability, expanded our ministries, and allowed us to build a strong foundation for the coming generation.

paragraphs.title: Perseverance Through Trials
paragraphs.content: The history of our church has not been without its challenges. Over the years, our journey has been marked by various obstacles and difficult circumstances. However, these trials served as tools to refine our faith and allow us to experience God’s faithfulness firsthand. Because the Lord has sustained us with His grace through every hurdle, our church stands today on a firm foundation.

paragraphs.title: Our Ministries Today
paragraphs.content:
Today, the Cologne Church is active in various areas of ministry to strengthen the spiritual life of its members:
 • Worship Ministry: Worship in spirit and truth that draws the hearts of believers closer to the Lord. 
 •Word Ministry: Timely and life-changing biblical teachings. 
 •In-depth Bible Study: Programs designed to help believers explore the Word of God and be deeply rooted in divine truth

statementOfFaith.title: Statement of Faith
statementOfFaith.intro: Our beliefs are rooted in Scripture and shape everything we do. Below is a summary of what we hold as truth.

items.title: Concerning the Holy Scriptures
items.text: We believe that the Bible (Old and New Testaments), consisting of 66 books, is the divinely inspired and immutable Word of God. 'Sola Scriptura' (Scripture Alone) is our sole and sovereign authority for faith, life, and church order. (2 Tim. 3:16-17)

items.title: Concerning the Trinity
items.text: We believe in one God, known through His eternal, infinite nature and as the Creator of all. This one God is revealed in three persons (Father, Son, and Holy Spirit), who are co-equal and co-eternal in nature, existence, and authority. While God is Triune, the three persons exist in unity (Coinherence) without confusion or division. We believe this divine mystery is the way God reveals Himself to believers and makes them partakers of His life. (Matt. 28:19-20)

items.title: Concerning the Lord Jesus Christ
items.text: We believe that the Lord Jesus Christ is the Son of God by nature, fully God and fully man. We believe He was born of the Virgin Mary through the overshadowing of the Holy Spirit; died on the cross for our sins; was buried; descended into Hades (the place of the dead) and conquered the power of death; and rose bodily on the third day. We believe He ascended into heaven, sits at the right hand of the Father, intercedes for us today, and will return in great glory. (Col. 1:19-20)

items.title: Concerning the Holy Spirit
items.text: Just as the Lord Jesus Christ came forth from the Father (John 8:42, 16:28), the Holy Spirit also proceeds from the Father (John 15:26) and is the third person of the Trinity with His own distinct agency. We believe the Holy Spirit is God, to be worshiped and glorified with the Father and the Son. He is a personal Spirit who sanctifies, guides, and comforts believers, and convicts the world of sin. (John 15:26, 16:12-14)

items.title: Concerning the Fall and Human Sinfulness
items.text: We believe that although man was created in the image and likeness of God, he fell through transgression, and as a result, sin entered the entire human race. Consequently, all humans are sinful by nature, are fallen short of the glory of God, and cannot escape the judgment of death and sin through their own efforts. Salvation is obtained only by grace (Sola Gratia) through faith in Christ Jesus. When a person repents and accepts the Lord, they are born again and receive the authority to be children of God. (Eph. 2:8, John 1:12-13)

items.title: The Fullness and Gifts of the Holy Spirit
items.text: We believe that a person saved by faith in Jesus Christ is sealed and filled with the Holy Spirit and receives the gifts of the Spirit (Eph. 1:13, Acts 2:4, 1 Cor. 12:7–11). We believe the Holy Spirit has a dual aspect of filling in a believer’s life: inward filling for the believer’s spiritual growth and sanctification, and outward filling that clothes the believer with spiritual power for service and gospel witness. We believe the various spiritual gifts given for the edification of the Church are still active today (1 Cor. 12:7–11).

hero.title: Youth Ministry
hero.subtitle: Guiding young people to grow in faith, character, and purpose.

youth.description: We invest in the next generation by equipping young people to live out their faith with courage and conviction.

sections.title: Our Vision
sections.text: The Children's Ministry is based on the biblical principle: 'Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it' (Proverbs 22:6). Our goal is to help children develop a personal relationship with Lord Jesus Christ and grow spiritually by knowing the Word of God from an early age. As written in Luke 2:52, 'And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men,' our ministry goes beyond merely babysitting children during worship services; we focus on teaching them to achieve holistic growth in the likeness of Christ.

sections.title: Our Core Values
sections.text:
To ensure parents can entrust us with their children with absolute peace of mind, we uphold the highest safety standards: 
 • Qualified Mentors: Our leaders are spiritually grounded, carefully vetted, and receive continuous training in both ministry and childcare. 
 • Safe & Engaging Environment: We maintain clean, child-friendly spaces that are regularly secured against potential hazards. Safe & Engaging Environment: We maintain clean, child-friendly spaces that are regularly secured against potential hazards. 
 • Active Supervision: We take our responsibility seriously. Children are never left unattended, ensuring a protective environment free from external risks. 
 • Transparent Communication: We value the partnership of parents. Our schedules are open, and parents are always welcome to observe our ministry or request updates.
